Thank you for examining SFT. A focused review of one statement is welcome. Use the sections that fit your report; you do not need to review the entire programme.

## Material examined

Link the paper DOI and version, source commit, or other exact material examined. Include page/equation references and full Lean declaration names where applicable.

## Scope and method

What did you examine, and how? Distinguish source reading, proof inspection, executed reproduction, and other methods. If you ran a check, include the command, relevant environment and result.

## Findings

Describe the reasoning and evidence for your conclusions, including supporting or contrary evidence. For a discrepancy, identify the exact source statement and corresponding implementation or output. Attach a minimal reproduction when useful.

## Suggested action or questions

What should the author clarify, correct, or investigate? This section may be left blank.

## Independence and disclosure

Please disclose relevant competing interests and any assistance used in preparing the review. Public affiliation and identity are optional here. Do not post private contact details, credentials or unpublished correspondence.
